mainEntity.name: What design considerations should I keep in mind for a small bathroom renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a small bathroom renovation, focus on maximizing space and light. Consider wall-mounted toilets, corner sinks, or floating vanities to free up floor space. Light-colored tiles, ample lighting, and large mirrors can make the room feel more expansive. As a practical tradeoff, while a larger shower might be desirable, sometimes a compact, well-designed shower or a shower-tub combo is more efficient for small footprints.
acceptedAnswer.description: For small bathrooms, maximize space and light using wall-mounted fixtures and light colors. A practical tradeoff is choosing efficient, compact showers over larger, less suitable designs.
